editorial:
Imagine giving up your biggest dreams to take care of your family. That is exactly what happens here. You follow a tough cop who really wants to see the world, but he stays home to look after his brother, who has a mental disability. The movie hits a sweet spot between being a funny comedy and a gritty crime story. It feels like a wild ride because one minute you are laughing at the sibling dynamic, and the next, you are on the edge of your seat when some nasty gangsters kidnap the brother. The bond between the two leads gives the story a lot of heart, making you really root for the cop to save his sibling.

What really makes this a winner is the action. Since Sammo Hung is directing, the fight scenes are top-notch and feel very real. The pacing is quick, and while some of the drama feels a bit old-school, the energy never drops. If you love classic martial arts and great stunts, you have to see this. It is a perfect pick for a weekend movie night with friends.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up with a massive, high-energy showdown between the cop and the gang. After a series of brutal fights, the cop finally tracks down the kidnappers and rescues his brother. The bad guys get exactly what they deserve in a satisfying final brawl. In the end, the cop realizes that his love for his brother is more important than his travel dreams, and they reunite as a happy, safe family.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic Hong Kong action and heartfelt stories.
watchReasons: great mix of comedy and drama
